items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: Sammy, uh, the Ten Dark Knights

ctx.x: So now we come to the age, we just beginning to butt out into the age of the Stomp and real jazz. Because before that it was Dixieland. When I was in Baron's, and when I left Atlantic City, it was Dixieland style. // But now, Dixieland was giving way, and such bands like, you know, some of the fellas from Ohio and Fletcher Henderson and my band and some of the other bands. Sammy, uh, the Ten Dark Knights -- we all played -- getting a little above Dixieland now, getting out of the five and six man band, and we're…
Where you had to have arrangements.
